description:
> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.*

Emit DEFK_ELIDED(i, len) around elided accesses (no-op in normal builds). In a check build it traps, catching wrong proofs that ASan cannot see (reads past a sub-binary's end into its parent). CBMC with a ~40-line harness proved flip/ws_mask/valid_utf8? safe at small sizes and caught every plant, but did not finish on lz4_block_decode or float kernels: use it for simple kernels only.
title: DEFK_ELIDED: mark every index whose bounds check the compiler removed; trap in a check build and verify simple kernels with CBMC
